PSG are back on top!
Paris Saint-Germain secured a crucial 2-0 victory over Olympique Lyonnais in Ligue 1, with Senny Mayulu breaking the deadlock in the 72nd minute before Mika Godts sealed all three points in the 84th.
Watch the key moments from PSG’s win at the Parc des Princes as the Parisian side climbs to the summit of the Ligue 1 table!
